_comment: Curated rows for the README 'Suite at a Glance' table, keyed by LAUNCHPAD_CATALOG id. scripts/docs/publish.mjs renders the table inside the AUTODOCS:SUITE_GLANCE region from LAUNCHPAD_CATALOG and refuses to run when a Launchpad app has no row here (or a row names an app that is not on the Launchpad), so pnpm docs:readme:check fails until a new app gets one.

b3.what: Project management - Kanban board, sprints, five views (board/list/timeline/calendar/workload)

banter.what: Team chat with LiveKit voice/video, transcripts, and AI agents as spoken call participants
banter.comparable: Slack or Microsoft Teams, with Zoom-style voice/video built in

basis.what: Governed metric layer - one certified definition per number, immutable version lineage, and an AI "why did it change" decomposition
basis.comparable: dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, Looker's LookML

bastion.what: Continuous compliance readiness for SOC 2 and ISO 27001 - nightly control checks against what really happened in the suite, tamper-evident evidence, a drafted fix for every unproven control, and an expiring auditor room

bay.what: Media review and approval - frame/timecode/region annotations, per-reviewer decisions, token-gated guest links, and 3D/FBX model review

beacon.what: AI knowledge base with semantic search (Qdrant) and a graph explorer
beacon.comparable: Notion or Confluence, with an Obsidian-style graph view

bearing.what: Goals and OKRs with key results linked to Bam tasks for automatic progress

bench.what: Analytics dashboards, widgets, ad-hoc queries, scheduled reports, anomaly detection

bill.what: Invoicing, expenses, recurring billing, PDF generation, profitability reports

bin.what: Digital asset management - object-storage backbone plus a structured-data (CSV/JSON/YAML) grid/tree editor with live co-editing
bin.comparable: Dropbox/Box, plus an Airtable-style data grid

blank.what: Forms with conditional logic routing, submissions export, AI-generated form definitions

blast.what: Email campaigns with templates, segments, tracking pixel, click redirect, engagement analytics

blip.what: App telemetry - log ingest, live viewer, saved views, watches/alerts, transforms, retention, and scheduled reports

blueprint.what: Structured diagrams - typed graph nodes and edges (flowcharts, org charts, ERDs, mindmaps) with ELK auto-layout and Mermaid import/export

board.what: Infinite-canvas whiteboard with shapes, stickies, and audio conferencing

bolt.what: Workflow automation - both a form-based trigger/condition/action builder and a visual node-graph editor
bolt.comparable: Zapier or Make (form side); n8n or Node-RED (graph side)

bond.what: CRM - contacts, companies, deals, pipeline stages, activity log, dedupe

book.what: Scheduling with public booking pages and mixed human-plus-agent availability

braid.what: Identity resolution - clusters each app's copy of a person or company into one confidence-scored golden profile with human-in-the-loop merge review

brief.what: Real-time collaborative documents with versioning and inline comments

bulwark.what: AI contract-obligation monitor - clause-cited obligation ledger, deadline radar, and drafted (never auto-sent) notices and vendor-compliance chases

bureau.what: Virtual office - a spatial floor map with rooms, live presence, knock-to-enter, teleport/summons, and LiveKit conferencing

burn.what: Contract scope and margin monitor - reads a signed SOW into a priced deliverable ledger and attributes every unit of work against it in dollars

bursar.what: Procurement leveling - reads a request into a scope tree, levels every vendor offer against it to show what each one leaves out, then watches spend against the awarded baseline

helpdesk.what: Customer support portal with ticket tracking, similar-ticket dedupe, and auto task creation
